title: Centered probabilities sum to zero
statement: Let $V$ be a finite nonempty set and let $p:V\to\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $\sum_{v\in V}p(v)=1$. Then $\sum_{v\in V}\bigl(p(v)-1/|V|\bigr)=0$.
